claim: When 'trans-his-pg' fails to connect inside start.ts initService, start.ts catches the error and omits connections['trans-his-pg'], so MainProcess does not initialize TransHisPgModel while transHisModelNames() still returns ['TransHisPgModel'] when TRANS_HIS_EXPORT_SOURCE=postgres.
flow: start.ts initService -> catch on trans-his-pg -> MainProcess.initializeModels -> BaseExportProcessor.validatePrerequisites

claim: svc-env.ts currently lists RECONCILE_MARIADB_HOST through RECONCILE_MARIADB_POOLSIZE in REQUIRED_KEYS right before EXPORT_STORAGE_PATH without listing TRANS_HIS_PG_HOST through TRANS_HIS_PG_POOLSIZE.
In data-transfers/main-process.ts, initializeModels iterates over Object.keys(this.connections) and instantiates ModelRegistry[alias] only for aliases present and ready in this.connections.

In dbHandler/postgres.ts, createConnection builds a DbConfig with DbType.POSTGRES, host: options.host!, port: options.port || 5432, database: options.database!, username: options.username, password: options.password, and poolSize: options.poolSize || 10.
In utils/trans-his-export-source.ts, transHisModelNames returns ['TransHisPgModel'] when getTransHisExportSource() === 'postgres' and ['TransHisModel'] otherwise.
In start.ts, if connections.default is falsy after the DB_LIST connection loop, initService throws 'CRITICAL: Default database failed to connect!'.

In defined/app-setting.ts, the 'trans-his-pg' entry in DB_LIST has type 'postgres' and maps hostEnvKey, portEnvKey, dbEnvKey, userEnvKey, passEnvKey, and poolSizeEnvKey to TRANS_HIS_PG_HOST, TRANS_HIS_PG_PORT, TRANS_HIS_PG_DB, TRANS_HIS_PG_USER, TRANS_HIS_PG_PASS, and TRANS_HIS_PG_POOLSIZE.
In security/vault.security.ts, checkMissingEnvVariable iterates over REQUIRED_KEYS and logs 'MIS_ENV_KEY: ' + keyMustHave when envVariable[keyMustHave] is falsy.
In start.ts, initService immediately rethrows any error from any database in DB_LIST inside the catch block and never logs 'Failed to connect DB'.
In defined/app-setting.ts, the 'trans-his-pg' entry in DB_LIST uses type 'mongodb' and uriEnvKey 'TRANS_HIS_PG_URI'.
